verdict.rationale: Community hands-on reports say Hoppscotch works without login and offers an offline workspace, but limited to a single one. First-party docs only show adjacent pieces: a desktop app, PWA install and self-hosting, with no explicit offline or local-only workspace documentation. missing for 10: first-party documentation of offline/local workspace mode, support for multiple offline workspaces, choosing a local directory for workspace data.

support.subject: As a developer, I can work fully offline in a local workspace without a cloud account

citations.quote: The downside is that only one workspace is available when offline; you can't point your Workspace data to a specific directory like Bruno does
Lovely to see that things aren't held behind a Login button, ala Postman and Insomnia
Hoppscotch Desktop App is a cross-platform desktop application that helps you create and manage API requests.
